questions.q: How did the engineers handle the hard mountain country between the Wahsatch and the Rocky Mountains?
choices: They blasted many long tunnels straight through
They wound the track around the difficulties
They built tall bridges over every valley
They gave up and sent travellers by stagecoach
questions.evidence: avoided its difficulties by winding around

questions.q: Why did Passepartout wish his master had not made the journey in winter?
choices: He hated wearing heavy coats
Snow on the wheels could ruin the tour
Aouda had caught a bad cold in the mountains
The trains did not run in winter
questions.evidence: the accumulation of snow, by blocking the wheels of the cars, would certainly have been fatal

questions.q: Whom did Aouda see walking on the platform at Green River?
choices: Elder William Hitch, the missionary
Colonel Stamp Proctor, who had insulted Fogg
A friend of Fogg's from the Reform Club
A police officer from London who was looking for Fix

questions.q: Aouda called her feeling for Mr. Fogg gratitude. What does the narrator suggest it really was?
choices: Only a fear of being left alone in America
Something more than gratitude
Respect for his skill at cards
A wish to return home to India
questions.evidence: which she called gratitude, but which, though she was unconscious of it, was really more than that

questions.q: Why did Aouda want to keep Mr. Fogg from seeing Colonel Proctor?
choices: She was afraid a meeting would lead to a dangerous fight
She thought the colonel would tell Fogg the truth about Fix
She wanted to speak to the colonel by herself first
She knew the colonel owed Fogg a great deal of money
questions.evidence: we could not prevent a collision which might have terrible results

questions.q: When Passepartout asked Fix if he would really fight for Mr. Fogg, what did Fix answer?
choices: He would only fight if the colonel struck first
He would do anything to get him back living to Europe
He would rather let Passepartout do all the fighting
He would fight only if Mr. Fogg asked him to

questions.q: Why did Fix suggest a game of whist to Mr. Fogg?
choices: To keep Fogg in his seat so he would not meet the colonel
To win back the money he had spent on the long journey from Hong Kong
To find out where Fogg had hidden the banknotes
To pass the time until the train reached Omaha
questions.evidence: we've got him. He won't budge.

questions.q: How did Aouda say she had learned to play whist?
choices: Her father taught her in Bombay
It is part of an English education
She learned it on the steamer
Passepartout showed her the rules
questions.evidence: It is part of an English education.

questions.q: Fix "was simply an adept" at whist. What does adept mean here?
choices: A beginner
An expert
A cheater
A watcher

questions.q: Why did the train stop after the breakfast served in the car?
choices: It had run out of water for the engine
A red signal blocked the way
A herd of buffalo was on the track
Snow had buried the rails ahead
questions.evidence: The train had stopped before a red signal which blocked the way.

questions.q: What did the signal-man say was wrong at Medicine Bow?
choices: The station had burned down in the night
The bridge was shaky and could not bear the train
The track had been washed away by a flood
Robbers were waiting beyond the river to stop the next train
questions.evidence: The bridge at Medicine Bow is shaky

questions.q: Why could the passengers not simply cross the river in a boat?
choices: There were no boats anywhere along the bank
The creek was swelled by rain into a rapid
The river was frozen too thin to hold a boat
The colonel refused to let anyone use his boat
questions.evidence: The creek is swelled by the rains.

questions.q: What plan did the engineer, Forster, suggest?
choices: Wait six hours for a train from Omaha
Cross the bridge at the very highest speed
Walk ten miles north to find a shallow ford
Repair the broken wires of the bridge
questions.evidence: by putting on the very highest speed we might have a chance of getting over

questions.q: How did Colonel Proctor feel about the engineer's plan?
choices: He was afraid and wanted to get off the train
He was delighted and thought it would work
He said the plan was foolish and dangerous
He did not care and went back to sleep

questions.q: What "simple idea" did Passepartout try to tell the other passengers?
choices: Telegraph Omaha and ask for a stronger engine
Cross the bridge on foot and let the train come after
Take the luggage off so the train would be lighter
Wait until morning, when the river would be lower
questions.evidence: it would be more natural for us to cross the bridge on foot, and let the train come after

questions.q: Why did Passepartout finally get back on the train without arguing more?
choices: Mr. Fogg ordered him to take his seat
He wanted to show a Frenchman could be as American as they
Fix whispered to him that the bridge had been mended that morning
He fell asleep and missed the rest of the talk
questions.evidence: a Frenchman can be as American as they

questions.q: What did the engineer do just before rushing at the bridge?
choices: Uncoupled the last two cars of the train
Backed the train nearly a mile
Let all the passengers off to walk
Added more coal and waited an hour
questions.evidence: backed the train for nearly a mile

questions.q: What is the main event at the end of this chapter?
choices: The train races over the weak bridge, which falls just after
The train crashes into the river and everyone must swim to the far bank
Fogg discovers Proctor and challenges him at the bridge
The passengers walk fifteen miles through the snow
questions.evidence: the bridge, completely ruined, fell with a crash into the rapids of Medicine Bow
